desc: AWS Security Hub integration for cloud security finding management. Supports listing and retrieving findings, updating workflow status and severity, adding notes, retrieving finding history, and querying insight results.

functions.label: List Findings
functions.name: list_findings
functions.desc: Retrieve Security Hub findings with optional filters for severity, workflow status, record state, and product name. Supports pagination.

inParameters.label: Severity Label
inParameters.name: severity_label
inParameters.desc: Filter by severity label (INFORMATIONAL, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

inParameters.label: Workflow Status
inParameters.name: workflow_status
inParameters.desc: Filter by workflow status (NEW, NOTIFIED, RESOLVED, SUPPRESSED)

inParameters.label: Record State
inParameters.name: record_state
inParameters.desc: Filter by record state (ACTIVE, ARCHIVED)

inParameters.label: Product Name
inParameters.name: product_name
inParameters.desc: Filter by product name (matched against ProductFields, not the top-level ProductName field)

inParameters.label: Max Results
inParameters.name: max_results
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of findings to return (1-100, default 100)

inParameters.label: Next Token
inParameters.name: next_token
inParameters.desc: Pagination token from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

outParameters.label: Next Token
outParameters.name: next_token
outParameters.desc: Pagination token for the next page of results

functions.label: Get Finding Details
functions.name: get_finding_details
functions.desc: Retrieve full details of a specific Security Hub finding by finding ID and product ARN. Raises an error if the finding is not found.

inParameters.label: Finding ID
inParameters.name: finding_id
inParameters.desc: The ARN or ID of the finding

inParameters.label: Product ARN
inParameters.name: product_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the product that generated the finding

functions.label: Update Finding Workflow Status
functions.name: update_finding_workflow_status
functions.desc: Update the workflow status of a Security Hub finding (NEW, NOTIFIED, RESOLVED, SUPPRESSED)

inParameters.label: Finding ID
inParameters.name: finding_id
inParameters.desc: The ARN or ID of the finding

inParameters.label: Product ARN
inParameters.name: product_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the product that generated the finding

inParameters.label: Workflow Status
inParameters.name: workflow_status
inParameters.desc: New workflow status for the finding

outParameters.label: Processed Findings
outParameters.name: processed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of successfully processed finding identifiers

outParameters.label: Unprocessed Findings
outParameters.name: unprocessed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of finding identifiers that could not be processed

functions.label: Update Finding Severity
functions.name: update_finding_severity
functions.desc: Override the severity label of a Security Hub finding

inParameters.label: Finding ID
inParameters.name: finding_id
inParameters.desc: The ARN or ID of the finding

inParameters.label: Product ARN
inParameters.name: product_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the product that generated the finding

inParameters.label: Severity Label
inParameters.name: severity_label
inParameters.desc: New severity label for the finding

outParameters.label: Processed Findings
outParameters.name: processed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of successfully processed finding identifiers

outParameters.label: Unprocessed Findings
outParameters.name: unprocessed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of finding identifiers that could not be processed

functions.label: Add/Update Finding Note
functions.name: add_update_finding_note
functions.desc: Add or update a note on a Security Hub finding

inParameters.label: Finding ID
inParameters.name: finding_id
inParameters.desc: The ARN or ID of the finding

inParameters.label: Product ARN
inParameters.name: product_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the product that generated the finding

inParameters.label: Note Text
inParameters.name: note_text
inParameters.desc: Text content of the note

inParameters.label: Note Updated By
inParameters.name: note_updated_by
inParameters.desc: Identifier of the user or process adding the note

outParameters.label: Processed Findings
outParameters.name: processed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of successfully processed finding identifiers

outParameters.label: Unprocessed Findings
outParameters.name: unprocessed_findings
outParameters.desc: List of finding identifiers that could not be processed

functions.label: Get Finding History
functions.name: get_finding_history
functions.desc: Retrieve the history of changes for a specific Security Hub finding. Supports optional time range and pagination.

inParameters.label: Finding ID
inParameters.name: finding_id
inParameters.desc: The ARN or ID of the finding

inParameters.label: Product ARN
inParameters.name: product_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the product that generated the finding

inParameters.label: Start Time
inParameters.name: start_time
inParameters.desc: Start of the time range for history (ISO 8601 format)

inParameters.label: End Time
inParameters.name: end_time
inParameters.desc: End of the time range for history (ISO 8601 format)

inParameters.label: Max Results
inParameters.name: max_results
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of history records to return (1-100, default 100)

inParameters.label: Next Token
inParameters.name: next_token
inParameters.desc: Pagination token from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

outParameters.label: Next Token
outParameters.name: next_token
outParameters.desc: Pagination token for the next page of results

functions.label: Get Insight Results
functions.name: get_insight_results
functions.desc: Retrieve the results of a Security Hub insight by insight ARN

inParameters.label: Insight ARN
inParameters.name: insight_arn
inParameters.desc: The ARN of the Security Hub insight

outParameters.label: Insight Results
outParameters.name: insight_results
outParameters.desc: List of insight result values with group-by attribute and counts
